protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed CWE-22 prefix-confusion containment failure. Filesystem storage resolves or joins the requested id beneath an allowed directory, then accepts the result with raw String.startsWith(dir/rootDir). A sibling such as public123 therefore passes for allowed public. CVE.org is PUBLISHED and GHSA-mm3p-j368-7jcr is not withdrawn.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed a60fb0d44b96c9f135af3295730c3da13fbc3e6c as the smallest public first-write of the vulnerable containment primitive: it replaces the prior path.relative check with !fsPath.startsWith(rootDir). Although its id.includes('..') guard blocked the later relative-path PoC, an absolute sibling id such as /cwd/public123/test.png contained no '..', resolved to itself, and passed the raw prefix test. ec5c15d2ecfa3a5c9c550b918f84cf2f87085f90 later enabled the advisory's ../public123 form but did not first-write the flaw.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed immediate parent 11d1e1aa86350a9f095a175844a09a0f9a6b598b is present and uses relative(this.dir, _src).includes('..') in src/input/fs.ts; the vulnerable filesystem startsWith containment check and src/source/filesystem.ts are absent from that parent.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: Confirmed a60fb0d44b96c9f135af3295730c3da13fbc3e6c is a single-parent direct commit. GitHub's associated-pulls endpoint returns an empty list, its message has no PR reference, and no public squash members are available to decompose; later rewrites 8953943942edf318afb286c60cc0a88e2a82c1b8 and 912203e03f42a8bc1c173777053065c966949ecf only carry the existing primitive forward.
protocol_checks.release_membership: Confirmed the BIC is an ancestor of both the last vulnerable and first patched tags v1.3.1/v1.3.2, v2.1.0/v2.1.1, and v3.1.0/v3.1.1. The vulnerable tags contain startsWith(rootDir/dir); the patched tags contain startsWith(rootDir/dir + '/'). This matches the CVE and GHSA affected ranges and fixed versions.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_unpatched_state: Confirmed advisory-cited 81693ddbfc062cc922e4e2406e8427ab4e3ad214 directly changes startsWith(dir) to startsWith(dir + '/') and adds the sibling-directory regression test; it is absent from v3.1.0 and is an ancestor of v3.1.1. Equivalent direct backports 81b86b14ac77f58f89602112309cad2cb3d8c16c and 94627ef55161ab8ea62956bbd71700a77643c03a are ancestors of v2.1.1 and v1.3.2 respectively.
protocol_checks.bic_only_ai_attribution: Confirmed from the BIC commit object and GitHub commit API: author and committer are human maintainer Pooya Parsa (GitHub login pi0), the message is 'feat!: rewrite ipx', trailers are empty, and there is no bot, Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, or other AI marker. Fix-commit attribution was not used to judge the BIC.

findings: The primary record correctly identifies the vulnerability mechanism, atomic BIC, parent, direct fixes, release membership, and BIC-only human attribution.
The potentially ambiguous timing is resolved: a60fb0d is already exploitable through an absolute sibling id; ec5c15d2 only broadens exploitation to the GHSA's relative ../public123 PoC.
NOT_AI is supported; the advisory is published and non-withdrawn, so FALSE_POSITIVE does not apply.
